title: onprem-airgap-offline-bundle-vendor-rke2-suse-microos-updates
author: Aisha Patel
description: Adds SUSE MicroOS-specific packaging and vendoring updates to the onprem airgap offline bundle generation. Motivation: customers running Private on SUSE MicroOS reported missing initramfs hooks and zypper repo metadata in our last offline bundles which caused node boot failures during kubelet initialization. This PR vendors RKE2 v1.25.8 images and required OS artifacts, adds SUSE-specific bootstrap scripts, improves TUF manifest generation for multi-distro bundles, and updates the rollback tooling to support delta rollbacks for vendored package sets. Changes include: vendored rke2 images (sha-pinned), zypper repo metadata and dracut hooks for MicroOS, signing and verification for SUSE tarballs, and docs/upgrade notes for operators. Includes an exhaustive test plan and manual verification steps used during validation. Related Linear tickets: ENG-4820, INF-301. The description, checklist, and testing notes are in the PR body. This is backwards-compatible with existing offline bundle formats but includes new distro flag handling in the bundle generator CLI.

release_notes: Add SUSE MicroOS packaging and bootstrap scripts to offline bundle generator.
Vendor RKE2 v1.25.8 images with sha pins and checksum verification.
TUF signing: separate tarball signing for SUSE artifacts and verification during install.
Rollback tooling: support delta rollbacks for vendored package sets.
testing_summary: Integration fixtures run against qemu MicroOS images and a 3-node rke2 cluster; validation includes boot+kubelet readiness, image verification, and offline install path. Manual verification performed in ENG-4820 environment and results uploaded to the PR thread.
upgrade_notes: Operators upgrading to this bundle should regenerate their offline bundle with --distro microos or use the provided suse bundles. During upgrade ensure boot partition has dracut hooks applied (installer step included). For rollback use the updated rollback-tooling which supports delta rollbacks; follow docs for the specific sequence. Back up /etc/rancher for stateful components before applying bundle.
